issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, Nullological Operators, IsTrue/IsFalse: is true/is false take Boolean arguments and return true only when the argument evaluates exactly true/false; otherwise false.
issues.evidence: Translated CQL: define NumIsTrue: 1 is true; define ZeroIsFalse: 0 is false; define StrIsTrue: 'true' is true. Actual SQL: 1 IS TRUE, 0 IS FALSE, 'true' IS TRUE. Native-loaded and forced Python fallback DuckDB both returned True for all three. Expected: false/non-Boolean operands must not use SQL truthiness; direct IsTrue(1) and IsFalse(0) already return false.
issues.root_cause: Unary CQL `is true`/`is false` lowered to SQL `IS TRUE`/`IS FALSE`, allowing DuckDB truthiness for static numerics and strings. Direct `IsTrue`/`IsFalse` function calls also translated dynamic Boolean FHIR paths as text unless the argument was translated in Boolean context.
issues.resolution: Lowered infix predicates to CQL `IsTrue`/`IsFalse` helper calls, translating operands in Boolean context so dynamic FHIR Boolean paths use `fhirpath_bool` while static non-Boolean literals remain false.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, Nullological Operators, Coalesce signatures: scalar overloads accept 2 through 5 same-typed arguments; more than 5 inputs must be represented as a List<T>; single list overload is also valid.
issues.evidence: Translated CQL accepted invalid scalar forms: Coalesce() -> NULL, Coalesce(1) -> COALESCE(1), Coalesce(null, null, null, null, null, 1) -> COALESCE(NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1). Expected: translation error for zero scalar args, one scalar arg, or more than five scalar args; Coalesce({}) and Coalesce({null, 1}) remain valid list overloads.
issues.root_cause: `_translate_coalesce()` normalized list overloads but did not validate scalar overload arity before lowering to SQL `COALESCE`.
issues.resolution: Added scalar arity validation for `Coalesce`: only 2 through 5 scalar arguments are accepted; the single-list overload is still reduced to `COALESCE` elements and empty/all-null lists return SQL NULL.
